title: Notch
summary: NOTCH, noun [G. to crack or flaw. It seems to be the same word in origin as niche, nick.] 1. A hollow cut in any thing; a nick; an indentation. And on the stick ten equal notches makes. 2. An opening

inlines.v: NOTCH, noun [G. to crack or flaw. It seems to be the same word in origin as niche, nick.] 1. A hollow cut in any thing; a nick; an indentation. And on the stick ten equal notches makes. 2. An opening or narrow passge through a mountain or hill. We say, the notch of a mountain. NOTCH, verb transitive To cut in small hollows; as, to notch a stick. NOTCH'-WEED, noun A plant called orach.
